title: data for notify.set
description: Owner configures how the coordinator hears about owner feedback and answers: pulled with `board watch` (server-sent events) or pushed to a webhook signed with HMAC-SHA256. The signing secret is generated by the server, returned once in this response (webhook_secret) and never journaled.

coordinator_feedback.description: Send owner feedback and answers to the webhook (when delivery is webhook).

rotate_secret.description: Generate a new signing secret; the old one stops working at once.
